claim.claim-text: a vaporizer body (102) including a cartridge receptacle (112), a heating element (122), and a first airflow path (118), the heating element (122) being disposed within the cartridge receptacle (112) and affixed to the vaporizer body (102); and a cartridge (104) that is selectively coupled to and removable from the vaporizer body (102), the cartridge (104) including a reservoir chamber (142) configured to contain a vaporizable material and a wicking element (144) that is in fluid communication with the reservoir chamber (142), the wicking element (144) being configured to draw at least a portion of the vaporizable material from the reservoir chamber (142); wherein the heating element (122) includes a heating portion (124) that extends from a first surface (126a) to a second surface (126b) that is opposite the first surface (126a), wherein the wicking element (144) and the first surface (126a) of the heating element (122) are brought into direct contact with each other in response to at least a portion of the cartridge (104) being seated within the cartridge receptacle (112) such that at least a portion of the vaporizable material received within the wicking element (144) is substantially vaporized to form vaporized material in response to activation of the heating element (122), and characterized in that a portion of the first airflow path (118) extends adjacent to the second surface (126b) of the heating portion (124).
2. The vaporizer device (100) of claim 1, wherein the cartridge (104) includes a second airflow path (120) that is in fluid communication with the first airflow path (118).

3. The vaporizer device (100) of claim 1 or 2, wherein the vaporizer body (102) includes at least one inlet (114) that is configured to substantially allow airflow to pass into the vaporizer body (102), and wherein the at least one inlet (114) is in fluid communication with the first airflow path (118).
4. The vaporizer device (100) of claim 2 or 3, wherein the second airflow path (120) extends from an inlet (105a) to an outlet (105b) of the cartridge (104).

5. The vaporizer device (100) of any one of the preceding claims, further comprising a support structure (136) that is affixed to the vaporizer body (102), wherein the heating element (122) is coupled to at least a portion of the support structure (136).
6. The vaporizer device (100) of claim 5, wherein the support structure (136) includes a base (138) and two opposing legs (140a, 140b) extending from the base (138).
7. The vaporizer device (100) of claim 6, wherein each of the two opposing legs (140a, 140b) is formed in a substantially T-shaped configuration.

8. The vaporizer device (100) of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the cartridge (104) includes at least one vent (158) that is configured to allow airflow to pass into the reservoir chamber (142).

9. The vaporizer device (100) of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the cartridge (104) includes a holding plate (150) having a wicking receptacle (146) defined therein, and wherein the wicking element (144) is at least partially disposed within the wicking receptacle (146).

10. The vaporizer device (100) of claim 9, wherein the holding plate (150) includes at least one dispense opening that extends through a wall thereof to allow at least a portion of the vaporizable material within the reservoir chamber (142) to pass therethrough and into the wicking receptacle (146).

11. The vaporizer device (100) of claim 9 or 10, wherein the holding plate (150) includes at least one retaining element that is configured to secure the wicking element (144) to the wicking receptacle (146).

12. The vaporizer device (100) of any one of claims 9-11, wherein the holding plate (150) includes at least one vent (158) extending therethrough, and wherein the at least one vent (158) is configured to allow airflow to pass into the reservoir chamber (142).
13. The vaporizer device (100) of any one of claims 9-12, wherein the holding plate (150) defines a portion of the reservoir chamber (142).

14. The vaporizer device (100) of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the heating portion (124) includes tines (130) that extend between a first end (128a) to a second end (128b) of the heating portion (124), wherein the tines (130) are spaced relative to each other to create holes through the heating element (122).
15. The vaporizer device (100) of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the cartridge (104) includes an internal channel (160) that extends adjacent and parallel to the reservoir chamber (142).
